title: Rust CLI Parity and Cutover
objective: Make Rust the canonical engine only after observable parity, migration, and rollback evidence.

stories.title: Rust CLI contract parity
stories.outcome: Implement status/inspect/plan/clean/configure equivalents against the new engine without TUI concerns.
acceptance_criteria: Read-only default is explicit and no flag implies clean.
Exit codes match the documented taxonomy.
verification: Golden CLI snapshots on all tier-1 OSes.

stories.title: Differential parity gate
stories.outcome: Run Python and Rust over the full normative fixture corpus in CI.
acceptance_criteria: All unexplained semantic differences fail CI.

stories.title: Migration and rollback packaging
stories.outcome: Define side-by-side invocation, data compatibility, and rollback from Rust candidate to Python reference during beta.
acceptance_criteria: Beta users can identify active engine/version.
No local state migration is irreversible before cutover.

stories.title: Canonical engine switch
stories.outcome: Promote Rust to stable only after functional, safety, compatibility, and operability gates pass.
acceptance_criteria: Owner-visible migration Safety Verdict is accepted.
Python remains tagged/archiveable as reference for at least one transition window.
Release notes state any intentional contract change.
verification: Full release evidence packet and independent verifier sign-off.
